question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes with this colophon?
premises: The colophon marks the end of a section.
The text named is Aṃśumān in the Kāśyapa tradition.
The chapter is identified as the fifty-sixth on the excellent ten-tāla rule.
inference: This concludes the fifty-sixth chapter, on the excellent ten-tāla rule, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, on the rule of the excellent ten-tāla system, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
